description: 自転車等駐輪場一覧 [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 目黒区. 自転車、原動機付自転車、自動二輪車の駐輪場、登録制自転車置場の一覧. Coverage: 目黒区. The portal files it under the publisher 目黒区. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設一覧, 生活行動, 自転車, 自転車置き場. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
